description: This file contains utility functions related to logic hooks in SuiteCRM, including loading, modifying, and writing hook configurations, as well as checking for existing hooks.

methods.name: get_hook_array
methods.description: Loads and returns an array of logic hooks for the specified module by including the corresponding file if it exists.

methods.name: check_existing_element
methods.description: Checks if a specific action exists within a hook array for a given event.

methods.name: replace_or_add_logic_type
methods.description: Builds a new logic hook configuration content with the given hook array.

methods.name: write_logic_file
methods.description: Writes the logic hook configuration to a file for a specific module.

methods.name: build_logic_file
methods.description: Constructs the PHP code for the logic hooks array based on the provided hook array.
